+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+
+from .utils import make_default_short_help
+
+
+def command_catalog(
+    commands: cabc.Iterable[tuple[str, str | None]], width: int = 45
+) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
+    """Build a list of ``(name, description)`` pairs from command help
+    texts, keeping the order of ``commands``.
+
+    Each description is condensed the same way Click shortens a
+    command's help for the command list in its parent's help page: only
+    the first paragraph is used, whitespace is collapsed, a leading
+    ``\\b`` no-wrap marker is omitted, the text ends at the first
+    sentence-ending period, and longer text is truncated on a word
+    boundary with ``...`` to fit within ``width`` characters.
+
+    :param commands: An iterable of ``(command_name, help_text)`` pairs.
+        It is not modified. A help text of ``None`` gives an empty
+        description.
+    :param width: The maximum length of each description, including the
+        ``...`` suffix. Must be at least 4.
+    :raise ValueError: If ``width`` is less than 4.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 8.2.2
+    """
+    if width < 4:
+        raise ValueError(f"'width' must be at least 4, got {width}.")
+
+    return [
+        (name, make_default_short_help(help_text or "", width))
+        for name, help_text in commands
+    ]

+import pytest
+
+from click.command_catalog import command_catalog
+
+
+def test_order_and_pairs():
+    commands = [("sync", "Sync files."), ("add", "Add a file."), ("rm", None)]
+    assert command_catalog(commands) == [
+        ("sync", "Sync files."),
+        ("add", "Add a file."),
+        ("rm", ""),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_accepts_generator():
+    commands = ((name, f"Run {name}.") for name in ("a", "b"))
+    assert command_catalog(commands) == [("a", "Run a."), ("b", "Run b.")]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("help_text", "width", "expect"),
+    [
+        pytest.param("", 10, "", id="empty"),
+        pytest.param("First.\n\nSecond paragraph.", 45, "First.", id="paragraph"),
+        pytest.param("one\n  two\tthree", 45, "one two three", id="whitespace"),
+        pytest.param("Do it. Then more.", 45, "Do it.", id="sentence"),
+        pytest.param("\b\nkeep   this", 45, "keep this", id="no-wrap mark"),
+        pytest.param("123 5678 xxxxxx", 10, "123...", id="truncate"),
+        pytest.param("123 567 90", 10, "123 567 90", id="exact width"),
+        pytest.param("see ~/.netrc for more", 45, "see ~/.netrc for more", id="dot"),
+        pytest.param("abcdefgh", 4, "...", id="min width"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_description(help_text, width, expect):
+    ((_, out),) = command_catalog([("cmd", help_text)], width=width)
+    assert out == expect
+    assert len(out) <= width
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [3, 0, -1])
+def test_width_too_small(width):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="at least 4"):
+        command_catalog([("cmd", "Help.")], width=width)
+
+
+def test_input_not_modified():
+    commands = [("a", "Help for a.\n\nMore."), ("b", "Help for b.")]
+    original = [tuple(pair) for pair in commands]
+    command_catalog(commands, width=8)
+    assert commands == original
